svg.title: Topograph Slurm Topology Formats
svg.desc: Slurm topology formats explainer showing an example discovered cluster topology and the tree, block, and per-partition YAML formats Topograph can emit for Slurm.
svg.text: A Slurm generation request emits cluster-wide topology.conf or per-partition topology.yaml.
Switch hierarchy plus accelerator domains that Topograph can translate for Slurm.
